scripts.text: Sorry, I'm not good at remembering people's faces! But I think you are not good enough to ask about my work here.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我不太擅长记人脸！不过我觉得你还没资格打听我的工作。

scripts.text: - This is a quest that can be performed at level 200 or higher -
scripts.translation: - 这是一个200级或以上才能进行的任务 -

scripts.text: Oh, {0}. Are you here for a drink?
I just had a business, and it went well.
scripts.translation: 我刚谈完一笔生意，进展得很顺利。

scripts.text: You know that Secret Wing and our rebellion have been tracking the traces of Illusion's illegal experiments, right?
scripts.translation: 你知道秘密翼和我们的反叛者一直在追踪幻觉非法实验的痕迹，对吧？

scripts.text: In the meantime, I found a way to the 4th floor of Rudus.
scripts.translation: 在此期间，我找到了通往鲁杜斯第四层的路。

scripts.text: Hehe, it's good to have a good conversation with {0}.
scripts.translation: 呵呵，能和{0}好好聊天真好。

scripts.text: What, how many times did you forget?
It was the place where Illusion abandoned the failed works that were created after the experiment.
scripts.translation: 那是幻觉在实验后遗弃失败品的地方。

scripts.text: Remember Morning? Where the little boy stays.
scripts.translation: 记得晨星吗？就是那个小男孩住的地方。

scripts.text: He is on the first floor, and Rudus itself exists on the second and third floors.
scripts.translation: 他在第一层，而鲁杜斯本身存在于第二层和第三层。

scripts.text: By the way, the 4th floor of Rudus is quite amazing...
scripts.translation: 顺便说一下，鲁杜斯的第四层相当惊人...

scripts.text: Somehow, among the test subjects abandoned in Rudus, only particularly strong ones seem to be gathered.
scripts.translation: 不知为何，被遗弃在鲁杜斯的实验体中，似乎只有特别强的那些聚集在那里。

scripts.text: Researchers of the Secret Wing say that after fierce competition among the subjects, the strongest subjects seem to have settled there.
scripts.translation: 秘密翼的研究员说，在实验体之间经过激烈的竞争后，最强的实验体似乎定居在那里了。

scripts.text: Well, actually, I'm not sure how complicated it is!
scripts.translation: 嗯，其实我也不确定情况有多复杂！

scripts.text: It seems that the Secret Wing researchers need to study the entities there.
scripts.translation: 看起来秘密翼的研究员需要研究那里的实体。

scripts.text: So I was looking for someone to help me.
Do you need a job? I know everything~
scripts.translation: 你需要工作吗？我什么都知道~

scripts.text: If you have an idea, go to the 3rd floor of Rudus.
scripts.translation: 如果你有个想法，就去鲁杜斯的第三层吧。

scripts.text: <NAVI>[Pion]<INFO>sp_rudus3,380,42,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> is in control of the path leading down to the fourth floor.
scripts.translation: <NAVI>[皮翁]<INFO>sp_rudus3,380,42,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> 控制着通往第四层的通道。

scripts.text: Go and tell him I sent you, and find out if it's worth it to come!
scripts.translation: 去告诉他是我派你来的，看看是否值得去！

scripts.text: Do you need a job? I know everything~
scripts.translation: 你需要工作吗？我什么都知道~

scripts.text: If you have an idea, go to the 3rd floor of Rudus.
scripts.translation: 如果你有个想法，就去鲁杜斯的第三层吧。

scripts.text: <NAVI>[Pion]<INFO>sp_rudus3,380,42,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> is in control of the path leading down to the fourth floor.
scripts.translation: <NAVI>[皮翁]<INFO>sp_rudus3,380,42,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> 控制着通往第四层的通道。

scripts.text: Go and tell him I sent you, and find out if it's worth it to come!
scripts.translation: 去告诉他是我派你来的，看看是否值得去！

scripts.text: Oh, you went down to the 4th floor of Rudus. How was it?
scripts.translation: 哦，你去了鲁杜斯的第四层。感觉如何？

scripts.text: Is Pian doing well? Did the subjects feel a bit worthy of a fight?
scripts.translation: 皮翁还好吗？实验体们感觉有点值得一战吗？

scripts.text: Then help me study the people from the Secret Wing.
scripts.translation: 那么帮我研究一下秘密翼的人吧。

scripts.text: I was looking for someone to hunt them, because I was not enough to catch and research monsters myself.
scripts.translation: 我一直在找人猎杀他们，因为我自己不够强，无法捕捉和研究魔物。

scripts.text: Ask if I can just hunt
scripts.translation: 问是否可以只进行猎杀

scripts.text: If you attach this chip somewhere on your body and hunt them, researchers can receive data.
scripts.translation: 如果你把这个芯片贴在身上某个部位去猎杀它们，研究员们就能接收到数据。

scripts.text: New material, eco-friendly, non-toxic, safe material, so you don't have to worry about it.
scripts.translation: 这是新材料，环保、无毒、安全，所以你不用担心。

scripts.text: Where would you like to hang it?
Okay, I'll attach it well so it doesn't bother you.
scripts.translation: 好的，我会贴好，确保不会让你感到不适。

scripts.text: Please take good care of me today!
So, what kind of research would you like to help with today?
scripts.translation: 那么，今天你想协助进行哪种研究？
秘密翼的研究员们正在休息。

scripts.text: So, {0}, how about coming back after a little rest?
scripts.translation: 所以，{0}，不如稍作休息后再回来？

scripts.text: The 4th floor of Rudus is not a comfortable place to go in and out easily.
scripts.translation: 鲁杜斯的第四层并不是一个可以随意进出的舒适之地。

scripts.text: Let's get some rest and work fully prepared!
scripts.translation: 让我们休息一下，做好充分准备再行动吧！

scripts.text: A place where only strong individuals survive and bite weaker ones...
scripts.translation: 一个只有强者才能生存，并狠咬弱者的地方...

scripts.text: Like a deep, dark pit of solitude.
scripts.translation: 就像深邃黑暗的孤寂深渊。

scripts.text: Well, I don't know about that!
My job is to deliver the requests of researchers.
scripts.translation: 我的工作是传达研究员们的请求。

scripts.text: Researchers want to know how the subjects of Rudus differ from those distributed on the 4th floor.
scripts.translation: 研究员们想知道鲁杜斯的实验体与分布在第四层的实验体有何不同。

scripts.text: How much more has it lost it's original form, and whether it has changed itself after the experiment.
scripts.translation: 它们失去了多少原本形态，以及在实验后是否发生了自我改变。

scripts.text: <FONT SIZE = 9>Um... these researchers look a little dangerous too? I think that's how all researchers are, to a person like me.</FONT>
scripts.translation: <FONT SIZE = 9>嗯...这些研究员看起来也有点危险？我觉得对我来说，所有研究员都是这样的。</FONT>

scripts.text: Anyway, you want to collect <FONT COLOR = 0000CD>Dolorian, Plagarion, and Deadre</FONT> data.
scripts.translation: 总之，你想收集<FONT COLOR = 0000CD>多洛里安、普拉格利安和迪德雷</FONT>的数据。

scripts.text: What if we hunt 10 individuals each?
scripts.translation: 如果我们各猎杀10只，怎么样？

scripts.text: We're already comrades on the same boat~?
scripts.translation: 我们已经是同一条船上的同志了~？

scripts.text: Isn't that right, comrade? Think again!
Okay, if you go hunting and from hunting, data will be gathered.
scripts.translation: 好的，如果你去猎杀，就能收集到数据。

scripts.text: And my allowance will be accumulating!
scripts.translation: 而且我的零花钱也会增加！

scripts.text: Secret Wing researchers want to collect <FONT COLOR = 0000CD>Dolorian, Plagarion, and Deadre</FONT> data.
scripts.translation: 秘密翼的研究员们想要收集<FONT COLOR = 0000CD>多洛里安、普拉格利安和迪德雷</FONT>的数据。

scripts.text: What if we hunt 10 individuals each?
scripts.translation: 如果我们各猎杀10只，怎么样？

scripts.text: Today's hunting seems to be successful!
scripts.translation: 今天的猎杀似乎很成功！

scripts.text: How did you know, {0}, the chip I put on you worked today.
scripts.translation: {0}，你是怎么知道的，我装在你身上的芯片今天起作用了。

scripts.text: I see it every time, but every time it's amazing, how the chip works.
scripts.translation: 我每次都看到，但每次都很惊讶，芯片是怎么工作的。

scripts.text: Well, I should pay you for the work you did today.
scripts.translation: 好了，我应该支付你今天的工钱。

scripts.text: Then since you've finished your work, take a good rest. Please take care of me tomorrow as well~
scripts.translation: 既然你完成了工作，就好好休息吧。明天也请多多关照~

scripts.text: Secret Wing researchers left work already.
scripts.translation: 秘密翼的研究员们已经下班了。

scripts.text: So, {0}, how about coming back after a little rest?
scripts.translation: 所以，{0}，你稍微休息一下再回来怎么样？

scripts.text: The 4th floor of Rudus is not a comfortable place to go in and out easily.
scripts.translation: 鲁杜斯的第四层不是一个可以随意进出的舒适地方。

scripts.text: You too, get a good rest, and let's work fully prepared!
scripts.translation: 你也好好休息，让我们以充分的准备状态工作！

scripts.text: The 4th-floor entities Giant Caput and Venedi are greatly altered from the other-floor entities
scripts.translation: 第四层的实体巨首和维内迪与其他楼层的实体相比，发生了巨大的变化，

scripts.text: to become gigantic, or to harbor more venom...
scripts.translation: 变得巨大，或者携带更多的毒液...

scripts.text: Researchers seem to be very interested in these guys.
scripts.translation: 研究员们似乎对这些家伙非常感兴趣。

scripts.text: That's why I ask you to hunt them.
scripts.translation: 所以我请你去猎杀它们。

scripts.text: <FONT SIZE = 9>Um...why don't we do it? There must be something complicated at the upper level. I don't know.</FONT>
scripts.translation: <FONT SIZE = 9>嗯...我们为什么不做呢？上层一定有什么复杂的事情。我不知道。</FONT>

scripts.text: Can you hunt 15 <FONT COLOR = 0000CD>Giant Caput and Venedi</FONT> each?
scripts.translation: 你能各猎杀15只<FONT COLOR = 0000CD>巨首和维内迪</FONT>吗？

scripts.text: Data will be collected automatically, so you just need to focus on hunting.
scripts.translation: 数据会自动收集，所以你只需要专注于猎杀。

scripts.text: We're already comrades on the same boat~?
scripts.translation: 我们已经是同一条船上的同志了~？

scripts.text: Isn't that right, comrade? Think again!
My bonus depends on your performance!
scripts.translation: 我的奖金取决于你的表现！

scripts.text: Can you hunt 15 <FONT COLOR = 0000CD>Giant Caput and Venedi</FONT> each?
scripts.translation: 你能各猎杀15只<FONT COLOR = 0000CD>巨首和维内迪</FONT>吗？

scripts.text: Data will be collected automatically, so you just need to focus on hunting.
scripts.translation: 数据会自动收集，所以你只需要专注于猎杀。

scripts.text: Have you been well? You came back from hunting safely.
scripts.translation: 你还好吗？你安全地从猎杀中回来了。

scripts.text: Please tell me that the researchers worked hard today.
scripts.translation: 请告诉我，研究员们今天工作很努力。

scripts.text: Looks like good data has been gathered.
scripts.translation: 看起来收集到了很好的数据。

scripts.text: Then I should pay you for the work you did today.
scripts.translation: 那么我应该支付你今天的工钱。

scripts.text: You worked hard today, so get a good rest and come back. Let's work hard tomorrow!
scripts.translation: 你今天工作很努力，所以好好休息，然后回来。让我们明天继续努力！

scripts.text: The researcher said he's withdrawn now. Chip maintenance is enough once a day!
scripts.translation: 研究员说他现在撤回了。芯片维护一天一次就够了！

scripts.text: So, {0}, how about coming back after a little rest?
scripts.translation: 所以，{0}，你稍微休息一下再回来怎么样？

scripts.text: The 4th floor of Rudus is not a comfortable place to go in and out easily.
scripts.translation: 鲁杜斯的第四层并不是一个可以随意进出的舒适之地。

scripts.text: Let's get some rest and work fully prepared!
scripts.translation: 让我们休息一下，做好充分准备再行动吧！

scripts.text: Oh, by the way, are the chips sticking well?
scripts.translation: 哦，顺便问一下，芯片粘得还好吗？

scripts.text: And I have to back up and format the data I have collected so that I can receive new data, but I don't have the talent to do that...
scripts.translation: 而且我必须备份并格式化我收集的数据，以便接收新数据，但我没有这方面的天赋...

scripts.text: I'll introduce you to a researcher who is currently in the field, would you like to go directly?
scripts.translation: 我可以介绍一位正在外勤的研究员给你，你想直接去找他吗？

scripts.text: He is probably disguised to observe monsters, but I'll give you the location, so go check it out!
scripts.translation: 他可能正在伪装观察魔物，但我可以告诉你他的位置，快去看看吧！

scripts.text: Isn't it frustrating to only work with me?
scripts.translation: 只和我一个人工作是不是很无聊？

scripts.text: It wouldn't be a bad idea to meet the researchers working in the field...
scripts.translation: 去见见在外勤的研究员也不错...

scripts.text: Yeah! Isn't it frustrating to only meet with me to get work delivered?
scripts.translation: 是啊！只和我一个人交接工作是不是很烦？

scripts.text: I'm on my way to see him, so if you have any questions, you can ask him directly!
scripts.translation: 我正准备去找他，如果你有什么问题，可以直接问他！

scripts.text: I heard that <NAVI>[Researcher]<INFO>sp_rudus4,192,204,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> mostly burrows around the center of the 4th floor of Rudus.
scripts.translation: 听说<NAVI>[研究员]<INFO>sp_rudus4,192,204,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>大多躲在鲁杜斯第四层的中央附近。

scripts.text: I'm on my way to meet the Secret Wing researcher, so if you have any questions, you can ask him directly!
scripts.translation: 我正准备去见秘密翼研究员，如果你有什么问题，可以直接问他！

scripts.text: I heard that <NAVI>[Researcher]<INFO>sp_rudus4,192,204,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> mostly burrows around the center of the 4th floor of Rudus.
scripts.translation: 听说<NAVI>[研究员]<INFO>sp_rudus4,192,204,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>大多躲在鲁杜斯第四层的中央附近。

scripts.text: Have you been there? Did you talk a bit?
He's known for hiding very well, even though he doesn't have the skills to hide.
scripts.translation: 他虽然不会隐匿技能，但据说藏得非常隐蔽。

scripts.text: That's why you're out in the field.
scripts.translation: 所以你就在外面待命吧。

scripts.text: Because this is also a job... Since I safely replaced him, the superiors asked me to take care of the allowance.
scripts.translation: 因为这也是工作的一部分...既然我安全地替换了他，上级就让我负责发放津贴。

scripts.text: Well, it's good that you came back to me too!
Then have a good day and see you tomorrow!
scripts.translation: 那么祝你今天愉快，明天见！

scripts.text: Excuse me, sir! No more work!
Seup, Ha-am... Down this slope is an access control area.
scripts.translation: 呼...哈...这个斜坡下方是管制区域。

scripts.text: People are not allowed to enter.
That... Still, I can't let you in on my own.
scripts.translation: 那个...但我不能擅自放你进去。

scripts.text: Oops... ah, this is definitely not saliva
scripts.translation: 哎呀...啊，这绝对不是口水。

scripts.text: It is a drop of sweat that shines with passion and effort.
scripts.translation: 这是闪耀着热情与努力的汗滴。

scripts.text: Hmm, hmmm. The entrance down this slope is now restricted...
scripts.translation: 嗯...嗯。这个斜坡下方的入口现在被封锁了...

scripts.text: I want to go to the 4th floor of Rudus.
Oh, there's a problem with your working attitude?
scripts.translation: 哦，你的工作态度有问题？
喂，有些人可能会睡觉的！！

scripts.text: Fourth floor? I'm in control right there...
scripts.translation: 四楼？我正好在这里负责管理...

scripts.text: Ah, did you come to see Yulma from Bullet Meow?
scripts.translation: 啊，你是来找子弹喵的尤尔玛的吗？

scripts.text: If you want to look at the specimens on the 4th floor and help with a research request, go back to <NAVI>[Yulma]<INFO>pub_cat,94,43,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> and ask.
scripts.translation: 如果你想查看四楼的标本并协助研究请求，请回到 <NAVI>[尤尔玛]<INFO>pub_cat,94,43,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> 处询问。

scripts.text: I'll move you to the 4th floor.
Are you sure you want to go down to the 4th floor of Rudus?
scripts.translation: 你确定要去鲁杜斯四楼吗？
我要传送你了。请多关照！

scripts.text: You have to watch a lot of monsters.
I got a call. Are you here to renew the chip?
scripts.translation: 我接到电话了。你是来更新芯片的吗？

scripts.text: Let's see... Let's get some chips.
scripts.translation: 让我看看... 我们来获取一些芯片。

scripts.text: Hmmmm... Connect with my machine... Empty data...
scripts.translation: 嗯... 与我的机器连接... 数据为空...

scripts.text: Okay, that's it! The data is clean and very nice. I'll paste it again.
scripts.translation: 好了，就是这样！数据很干净，非常好。我会再次粘贴它。

scripts.text: Because this is also a job, <NAVI>[Yulma]<INFO>pub_cat,94,43,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> will give you a small allowance when you return.
scripts.translation: 因为这也是一份工作，<NAVI>[尤尔玛]<INFO>pub_cat,94,43,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> 会在你回来时给你一点津贴。

scripts.text: I am always indebted to you. Good job!
Evil! If you pretend to know, monsters will come!
scripts.translation: 邪恶！如果你假装认识，魔物就会来的！

scripts.text: I would like to do more research, but if my life is really in danger...
scripts.translation: 我想做更多的研究，但如果我的生命真的处于危险之中...

scripts.text: I have no choice but to hire a strong and sincere adventurer. Hmm...
scripts.translation: 我别无选择，只能雇佣一位强大且真诚的冒险者。嗯...

scripts.text: I think level 200 would be enough... It's easy to say, but that is not the type of person who can be easily found.
scripts.translation: 我觉得200级就足够了... 说起来容易，但那种人并不容易找到。

scripts.text: Oh, oh my, my gosh. The strong and sincere adventurer I've been looking for has appeared here.
scripts.translation: 哦，天哪，我的天。我一直在寻找的强大且真诚的冒险者出现了。

scripts.text: Would you like to help me with my research?
scripts.translation: 你愿意帮助我的研究吗？

scripts.text: Even if I look at you with my eyes I recognize your skills at a glance, please do something...!
scripts.translation: 虽然我一眼就能看出你的实力，但还是请你帮个忙...！

scripts.text: No, that's it... Everyone refused, so the hanging words got stuck in my mouth.
scripts.translation: 不，就这样吧...大家都拒绝了，所以这句话一直卡在喉咙里。

scripts.text: Come on, that's it. Of course someone as talented as you can go to Niflheim.
scripts.translation: 好了，就这样吧。像你这样有才华的人当然可以去尼弗尔海姆。

scripts.text: Of course I don't have many days left and it's not the right time for me to go and I can't come back in time.
scripts.translation: 我时日无多，现在也不是我动身的时机，而且我也回不来了。

scripts.text: According to recent sources... Deep in the darkness of Niflheim, the dead hold a banquet,
scripts.translation: 根据最近的消息...在尼弗尔海姆深处的黑暗中，死者正在举行宴会，

scripts.text: in a form we cannot imagine.
scripts.translation: 其形式是我们无法想象的。

scripts.text: But there is nowhere to hear more about it.
You'll find out soon anyway, but I'm curious now.
scripts.translation: 你很快就会知道的，但我现在很好奇。

scripts.text: Can you take a look? I'll give you plenty of examples.
scripts.translation: 你能去看一下吗？我会给你足够的报酬。

scripts.text: That's enough. Can I come back?
What if I can't come back?
You wouldn't even think that you wouldn't be able to come back at your level...
scripts.translation: 以你的等级，你不会觉得回不来吧...

scripts.text: If you're still that careful, okay. Come back when you're ready.
scripts.translation: 如果你还是这么谨慎，好吧。等你准备好了再来。

scripts.text: Thank you. Turns out I forgot to introduce myself.
scripts.translation: 谢谢。原来我忘了自我介绍。
我叫加里姆·斯普林菲尔德。

scripts.text: I worked at Sage Castle for a long time... Now that I'm retired, I want to spend some leisure time here and also put in requests...
scripts.translation: 我在贤者城堡工作了很多年...现在退休了，想在这里度过闲暇时光，顺便发布一些委托...

scripts.text: Grant an idle old man a wish.
scripts.translation: 满足一个闲散老人的愿望。

scripts.text: Then I'll wait for the good news.
What are you doing? Go fast.
Huh? Did you really visit the banquet hall deep in Niflheim?
scripts.translation: 咦？你真的去了尼弗尔海姆深处的宴会厅？

scripts.text: Okay then, tell me your story.
I am prepared like this, so I won't be afraid if I go later!
scripts.translation: 既然我已经做好了准备，之后我去也不会害怕了！

scripts.text: I felt like I could do research even after dying, so I felt better.
scripts.translation: 我觉得即使死后也能继续研究，所以感觉好多了。

scripts.text: What's the fuss that you can't sleep even after you're dead?
scripts.translation: 吵死了，都死了还睡不着，真够烦人的。

scripts.text: I'm going to die because of the noise.
scripts.translation: 再吵下去我要被吵死了。

scripts.text: Huh? What? I don't deal with peddlers.
scripts.translation: 咦？什么？我不跟货郎打交道。

scripts.text: Oh, I did mean to ask you if you had sleeping pills... But I'm dead... You won't hear me... Hmm.
scripts.translation: 哦，我本来想问问你有没有安眠药...但我已经死了...你听不见我说话...嗯。

scripts.text: My complexion must look real bad...

scripts.text: I would like to ask you to hunt <FONT COLOR = 0000CD>{0} and {1}</FONT> among the chimeras in culture.
scripts.translation: 我想请您在培养中的凯美拉中，猎杀<FONT COLOR = 0000CD>{0}和{1}</FONT>。

scripts.text: You will be able to recognize them right away as the attribute characteristics of earth and fire appear much stronger than those of existing entities.
scripts.translation: 由于土属性和火属性的特征比现有的生命体更为强烈，您应该能一眼认出它们。

scripts.text: Actually, it's more like a monster than a homunculus...
scripts.translation: 实际上，它们更像魔物而非生命体...

scripts.text: Despite the destruction of the culture facility, the number of individuals continues to increase, so I would like to ask you to hunt about 15 specimens of each!
scripts.translation: 尽管培养设施已被破坏，但个体数量仍在增加，所以我想请您每种猎杀约15只！

scripts.text: Hmm? Have you changed your mind?
Well, then! We have to re-organize! Ugh.
scripts.translation: 好吧！我们得重新整理一下！唉。

scripts.text: Hero, why don't you reconsider calmly?
scripts.translation: 英雄，您不妨冷静地再考虑一下？

scripts.text: Thank you very much for your support. The two types of chimeras will probably be roaming the ground floor of the closed lab Amicitia.
scripts.translation: 非常感谢您的支持。这两种凯美拉可能会在封闭的实验室Amicitia的一楼游荡。

scripts.text: Please don't let the chimeras leave the lab.
scripts.translation: 请别让凯美拉离开实验室。

scripts.text: <FONT COLOR = 0000CD>{0} and {1}</FONT> will be roaming the first floor of the closed lab Amicitia.
scripts.translation: <FONT COLOR = 0000CD>{0}和{1}</FONT>将在封闭的实验室Amicitia的一楼游荡。

scripts.text: Have you been there? You have completed all the tasks I mentioned.
scripts.translation: 您去过那里吗？您已完成我提到的所有任务。

scripts.text: Rebellion units are also on duty.
Thanks to the hero who organized it one step ahead, it seems to have made it easier to enter.
scripts.translation: 多亏了提前一步整理好一切的英雄，进入似乎变得更容易了。

scripts.text: As expected from a hero. It is rare to find someone outside of the Rebellions who works with such sincerity and cleanliness.
scripts.translation: 不愧是英雄。在反叛者之外，很少有人能如此真诚且干净利落地工作。

scripts.text: I would be grateful if you could join the mission tomorrow as well.
scripts.translation: 如果您明天也能参加任务，我将不胜感激。

scripts.text: Now, the Rebellion unit is in the process of following up.
scripts.translation: 现在，反叛者部队正在跟进处理。

scripts.text: It's okay, hero, to rest a little longer.
scripts.translation: 英雄，您可以再休息一会儿。

scripts.text: Thank you for being so active with us.
scripts.translation: 感谢您一直以来的积极协助。

scripts.text: Can you come back after dawn?
scripts.translation: 您能在黎明之后回来吗？

scripts.text: I would like to ask you to hunt <FONT COLOR = 0000CD>{0} and {1}</FONT> among the chimeras that were being cultured.
scripts.translation: 我想请您在正在培养的凯美拉中，猎杀<FONT COLOR = 0000CD>{0}和{1}</FONT>。

scripts.text: It's not difficult to tell them apart because they've mutated into an appearance that clearly reveals the attributes of wind and water.
scripts.translation: 它们变异成了明显显现风属性和水属性特征的外观，因此很容易区分。

scripts.text: The number of individuals continues to increase without the help of a culture facility, so please hunt 15 of each.

scripts.text: Working with someone outside of Rebellion, this is the first time I've felt such a good fit.
scripts.translation: 与反叛者之外的人合作，这是我第一次感到如此契合。

scripts.text: Hero, would you like to join the mission tomorrow as well?

scripts.text: Can you come back after dawn?
scripts.translation: 您能在黎明之后回来吗？

scripts.text: This is a high-security job, so I only want to ask the hero a favor.
scripts.translation: 这是一项高保密任务，所以我只想拜托英雄您一件事。

scripts.text: I didn't want to go through the mouths of as many people as possible, so the Rebellion units were excluded from this job.
scripts.translation: 我不想让尽可能多的人知道，所以反叛者部队被排除在这次任务之外。

scripts.text: Nothing else, but to find <FONT COLOR = 0000CD>Traces of Werner</FONT> on the 1st floor of the abandoned lab Amicitia.
scripts.translation: 没有其他要求，只需在废弃实验室阿米西提亚的一楼寻找<FONT COLOR = 0000CD>维尔纳的痕迹</FONT>。

scripts.text: What part of Amicitia was managed by Werner, what kind of experiments he conducted, etc...
scripts.translation: 维尔纳负责管理阿米西提亚的哪个部分，他进行了什么样的实验，等等...

scripts.text: If anything has had an impact on the Institute, please come to me.
scripts.translation: 如果有任何对研究所造成影响的东西，请告诉我。

scripts.text: Documents, files, data! Anything is fine.
scripts.translation: 文件、档案、数据！什么都行。

scripts.text: Would you like to go for me?
That's alright. But it's also annoying...
scripts.translation: 没关系。但这也很令人烦恼...

scripts.text: I would appreciate it if you could keep this request a secret.
scripts.translation: 如果您能保守这个请求的秘密，我将不胜感激。

scripts.text: Okay. It won't be easy to find... Any traces, so please come back to me with just one.
scripts.translation: 好的。寻找痕迹并不容易...只要找到任何痕迹，请带着一份回来给我。

scripts.text: Then, I would like to thank you.
It won't be easy to find... Any traces, so please come back to me with just one.
scripts.translation: 寻找痕迹并不容易...只要找到任何痕迹，请带着一份回来给我。

scripts.text: Then, I would like to thank you.
You've come to the right place. This note is in Werner's handwriting.
scripts.translation: 您来对地方了。这张纸条是维尔纳的笔迹。

scripts.text: Thank you. We will hand this over to the secret wing agents for investigation.
scripts.translation: 谢谢。我们会将此交给秘密部门特工进行调查。

scripts.text: Then you should be rewarded for your hard work.
scripts.translation: 那么您应该会因为您的辛勤工作而获得奖励。

scripts.text: Thank you for coming back tomorrow and working with me.
scripts.translation: 感谢您明天回来协助我。

scripts.text: Because I can't just leave this to anyone.
scripts.translation: 因为这件事，我不能随便交给任何人。

Well, then! We have to re-organize! Ugh.
scripts.translation: 好吧！我们得重新整理一下！唉。

scripts.text: There is something on the floor. Shall we take a closer look?
scripts.translation: 地上有东西。我们要不要凑近看看？

scripts.text: Research memo in neat handwriting. Werner's handwriting is exactly like this.
scripts.translation: 这是一份字迹工整的研究备忘录。维尔纳的字迹正是这样的。

scripts.text: Let's take it and check it out.
scripts.translation: 我们把它拿起来检查一下。

scripts.text: It looks like it's just garbage.
Wow, {0}! Can I get an autograph?

scripts.text: Hero, there was a homunculus intensive culture room on the second floor of the Amicitia lab.
scripts.translation: 英雄，阿米西亚实验室的二楼有一个生命体强化培养室。

scripts.text: They were creating more powerful mutated chimeras.
scripts.translation: 他们正在制造更强大的变异凯美拉。

scripts.text: It's pitiful, but if they are released from the lab, they will do more damage than you can imagine.
scripts.translation: 虽然很可怜，但如果它们从实验室逃脱，造成的破坏将超出您的想象。

scripts.text: Can you help me clean up these chimeras?
scripts.translation: 您能帮我清理这些凯美拉吗？

scripts.text: Have you already been there today? If so, how about taking a break?
scripts.translation: 您今天已经去过那里了吗？如果是的话，不如休息一下？

scripts.text: If you overwork your body, you may not do well.
scripts.translation: 如果过度劳累，身体可能会吃不消。

scripts.text: Come back after dawn and work with us!
scripts.translation: 请在黎明之后回来，与我们一起工作！

scripts.text: Some of the work they were doing in the incubator was mass production of mutated chimeras.
scripts.translation: 他们在孵化器中进行的一些工作，是批量生产变异凯美拉。

scripts.text: They re-mutated the mutated homunculus and further strengthened their aggression.
scripts.translation: 他们对变异的生命体进行了再次变异，并进一步增强了它们的攻击性。
请各猎杀15只 <FONT COLOR = 0000CD>{0} 和 {1}</FONT>。

scripts.text: Both are creatures that imitate human form, but add a powerful transformation of the chimera properties to it.
scripts.translation: 它们都是模仿人类形态的生物，但在此基础上增加了强大的凯美拉特性变异。

scripts.text: It's been quite some time since the lab was closed and left unattended.
scripts.translation: 实验室关闭并无人看管已经有一段时间了。

scripts.text: A quick hunt would make me feel more comfortable.
scripts.translation: 快速清理一下，我会更安心。

scripts.text: But it was our one-sided request.
scripts.translation: 但毕竟是我们单方面的请求。

scripts.text: Even if you refuse, we can't help it...
scripts.translation: 即使您拒绝，我们也无可奈何...

scripts.text: It's an honor that you help us!
scripts.translation: 您愿意帮助我们，真是荣幸！

scripts.text: Can I participate with you hero?
scripts.translation: 英雄，我可以和您一起行动吗？

scripts.text: He doesn't like it. He is more comfortable doing it alone, calm down, Gerbena.
scripts.translation: 他不喜欢那样。他更喜欢独自行动，冷静点，格尔贝娜。
